name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Power hit in 9 regions; 709 drones (4 Nov)
summary: Russian strikes damage power sites in nine Ukrainian regions; both sides trade hundreds of drones
state: Zelensky said Russian overnight attacks into 4 Nov damaged power facilities and substations in nine regions, including Odesa, Kharkiv and Dnipro; Ukraine's air force said it shot down 272 drones (ABC News). Russia said it downed 709 Ukrainian drones, and Belgorod officials reported three deaths from Ukrainian strikes on 4 Nov (Al Jazeera). This follows the 2 Nov strike on an aid point in Zaporizhzhia region; US-mediated talks are planned in Abu Dhabi in mid-November.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice: it advises against all travel to Ukraine. Energy-sector strikes tend to bring rolling power cuts across Ukraine.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strikes and large-scale strikes on energy infrastructure = significant escalation (Alert)

sources.title: ABC News — Ukraine and Russia trade hundreds of drones overnight
